blocks.text: **if** («agar», «`-sa`») mumkin bo'lgan shartni bildiradi: shart bajarilsa — natija bo'ladi. «Agar ertaga yomg'ir **yog'sa**, uyda **qolamiz**» — **If** it **rains** tomorrow, we**'ll stay** at home. Bu **real** shart: yomg'ir yog'ishi ham, yog'masligi ham mumkin. Gap ikki qismdan iborat: **if** li qism (shart) va asosiy qism (natija). O'zbekchada «agar» ni tushirib qoldirish mumkin («Yomg'ir yog'sa ...»), chunki shartni `-sa` qo'shimchasi bildiradi. Inglizchada fe'lda bunday qo'shimcha yo'q — shartni faqat **if** bildiradi, shuning uchun u hech qachon tushib qolmaydi.
if dan keyin will emas — Present Simple

Shart kelajakka tegishli bo'lsa ham, **if** li qismda **Present Simple** ishlatiladi: If it **rains** («if it will rain» emas). Bu 98-darsdagi **when** qoidasining aynan o'zi: kelajakni asosiy qismdagi **will** ko'rsatadi. O'zbekchada ham `-sa` shaklida zamon yo'q: «borsam», «ko'rsam», «bo'lsa» — shuning uchun «`-sa` → Present Simple» deb eslab qoling. Uchinchi shaxs birlikda `-s` ni unutmang: if she **comes**, if it **rains**.

items.text: **If** I **see** Bekzod, I**'ll give** him your message.
We**'ll be** late **if** we **don't leave** now.
**If** the weather **is** nice, we**'ll have** a barbecue.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «If it **will rain**, ...» → If it **rains**, ... ; «If you **will come**, I'll be happy.» → If you **come**, ... ; «If she **come** ...» → If she **comes** (`-s` ni unutmang!); «If I will have time» → If I **have** time. Natija qismida **will** ni tushirib qoldirish ham xato: «If you hurry, you catch the bus» → you**'ll** catch the bus.

Ikkala tartib ham to'g'ri: **If** you're hungry, there's some soup in the fridge. = There's some soup in the fridge **if** you're hungry. **if** li qism oldin kelsa — vergul qo'yiladi, keyin kelsa — vergul kerak emas. O'zbekchada shart deyarli doim oldin turadi; inglizchada esa natijani oldin aytish ham juda tabiiy, ayniqsa so'zlashuvda.

items.text: **If** you**'re** hungry, there's some soup in the fridge.

blocks.text: Natija qismida faqat **will** emas, boshqa shakllar ham keladi: **can** (imkoniyat), **might** (balki), **should** (maslahat), **be going to** (reja), buyruq gap (iltimos, ko'rsatma) va Present Simple (har doim to'g'ri bo'ladigan narsa). **if** li qism esa hamma holatda bir xil — Present Simple.

rows: If you ask her, she**'ll say** yes.
If you have time, you **can visit** the museum.
If it's sunny, we **might go** to the lake.
If you feel ill, you **should stay** in bed.
If you get lost, **ask** a police officer.
If you press this button, the door **opens**.

blocks.text: Savolda **will** asosiy qismda turadi: What **will** you do if you miss the bus? — Avtobusdan qolsang, nima qilasan? Inkor shart — **if** ... **don't** / **doesn't** / **isn't**: If you **don't** take a map, you'll get lost. Bu o'zbekchadagi «`-masa`» shakli: ol**masang**, kel**masa**, bo'l**masa**.

items.text: **If** Tom **doesn't come**, we**'ll start** without him.

blocks.text: **when** — voqea **albatta** bo'ladi, gap faqat vaqti haqida: I'll call you **when** I get home (uyga albatta boraman). **if** — voqea bo'lishi **ham, bo'lmasligi ham mumkin**: I'll call you **if** I'm late (kechikishim aniq emas). O'zbekchadagi `-sa` ikkala ma'noni ham beradi: «Uyga borsam, qo'ng'iroq qilaman» — aslida **when**; «Kechiksam, qo'ng'iroq qilaman» — **if**. Shuning uchun tarjima qilishdan oldin o'ylang: bu voqea aniq bo'ladimi?

rows: I'll phone you **if** there's a problem.

items.text: **When** I **wake** up tomorrow, I'll make breakfast.
**If** I **wake** up early tomorrow, I'll go for a run.

blocks.text: Eslab qolish: **if** va **when** dan keyin **will** yo'q. «Agar ... `-sa`» (balki bo'lar, balki yo'q) → **if**; «`-ganda`, `-gach`» (albatta bo'ladi) → **when**.

Bog'lanish: **when**, **before**, **until** → 98-dars (xuddi shu qoida); xayoliy shart — If I **had** money, I **would** ... → 100-dars; **will** → 27–28-darslar; **might** → 29-dars; **should** → 32-dars.

rows: If you're tired, you **can** go to bed.
If you **mix** blue and yellow, you **get** green.

examples.title: **If** + present, ... **will** ...: possible results
examples.description: Real shart: **if** li qismda Present Simple, natijada **will**. Ikkala tartib ham to'g'ri; **if** li qism oldin kelsa — vergul.

sentences.text: **If** it **rains** on Sunday, we**'ll stay** at home and watch films.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni yomg'ir **yog'sa**, uyda **qolib**, film ko'ramiz.

sentences.text: I**'ll help** you with your homework **if** you **want**.
**If** Aziz **gets** the job, he**'ll move** to Tashkent.
You**'ll feel** better **if** you **sleep** for a few hours.
sentences.translation: Bir necha soat **uxlasangiz**, o'zingizni yaxshiroq **his qilasiz**.

sentences.text: My mum **will be** very happy **if** you **come** to dinner.
**If** we **leave** now, we**'ll catch** the 8.30 train.
The teacher **will be** angry **if** we**'re** late again.
Emma **will lend** you her bike **if** you **ask** her nicely.
Dilnoza **will win** the competition **if** she **practises** every day.
sentences.translation: Har kuni **mashq qilsa**, Dilnoza musobaqada **g'olib bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: There**'ll be** a lot of traffic **if** we **go** by car.

examples.title: Negative: **if** ... **don't**, ... **won't**
examples.description: Inkor shart — **if** ... **don't** / **doesn't** / **isn't** (o'zbekcha «`-masa`»), inkor natija — **won't**. Tasdiq va inkor yonma-yon.

sentences.text: **If** you **don't hurry**, you**'ll miss** the bus.
We **won't go** to the beach **if** the weather **isn't** good.
**If** I **don't see** you tomorrow, I**'ll call** you at the weekend.
sentences.translation: Ertaga seni **ko'rmasam**, dam olish kunlari **qo'ng'iroq qilaman**.

sentences.text: Your plants **will die** **if** you **don't water** them.
Madina **won't pass** the exam **if** she **doesn't study** harder.
**If** the shop **is** closed, we **won't have** any bread for breakfast.
Nobody **will know** **if** you **don't tell** them.
I **won't come** to the party **if** Bekzod **isn't** there.
The baby **will wake up** **if** you **aren't** quiet.
You **won't find** a good job in tourism **if** you **don't speak** English.
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilini **bilmasangiz**, turizm sohasida yaxshi ish **topolmaysiz**.

examples.title: Questions: What will you do **if** ...?
examples.description: Savol-javob: savolda **will** natija qismida, **if** li qismda — Present Simple. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I will. / No, he won't.

sentences.text: What **will** you **do** **if** you **miss** the last bus? — I**'ll take** a taxi.
**If** it **snows** tonight, **will** the schools **be** closed tomorrow? — Maybe.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechasi qor **yog'sa**, ertaga maktablar **yopiq bo'ladimi**? — Balki.

sentences.text: Where **will** you **stay** **if** the hotel **is** full? — With my cousin.
**Will** you **buy** this flat **if** the price **goes** down? — Yes, I will.
What **will** your parents **say** **if** you **come** home late? — They'll be angry.
sentences.translation: Uyga kech **kelsang**, ota-onang nima **deydi**? — Jahli chiqadi.

sentences.text: **If** I **lend** you my laptop, **will** you **bring** it back on Friday? — Of course.
How **will** you **get** home **if** there **are** no taxis? — I'll walk.
**Will** James **be** upset **if** we **don't invite** him? — No, he won't.
sentences.translation: Jeymsni **taklif qilmasak**, u **xafa bo'ladimi**? — Yo'q, xafa bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: Who **will water** your plants **if** you **go** to Samarkand for a month? — My sister will.
sentences.translation: Bir oyga Samarqandga **ketsang**, gullaringni kim **sug'oradi**? — Singlim.

sentences.text: **If** I **press** this red button, what **will happen**? — Nothing, it's broken.
sentences.translation: Shu qizil tugmani **bossam**, nima **bo'ladi**? — Hech narsa, u buzuq.

examples.title: **If** ... **can** / **might** / **should** ...
examples.description: Natija qismida **will** o'rnida boshqa modal fe'llar: **can** (mumkin), **might** (balki), **should** (maslahat), **be going to** (reja).

sentences.text: **If** you **finish** early, you **can go** home.
We **might go** to the mountains **if** the weather **is** nice.
**If** your tooth still **hurts** tomorrow, you **should see** a dentist.
sentences.translation: Tishing ertaga ham **og'risa**, tish shifokoriga **borishing kerak**.

sentences.text: Tom **can stay** with us **if** he **comes** to Tashkent.
I**'m going to buy** two tickets **if** they **aren't** too expensive.
You **should take** an umbrella **if** you**'re going** out.
Sarah **might not come** **if** she **has** to work late.
**If** we **save** enough money, we **can travel** to London next summer.
sentences.translation: Yetarlicha pul **yig'sak**, kelasi yoz Londonga **sayohat qila olamiz**.

sentences.text: Children **can't swim** here **if** there **isn't** an adult with them.
sentences.translation: Yonida kattalar **bo'lmasa**, bolalar bu yerda **cho'milishi mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: Your English **might improve** quickly **if** you **watch** films without subtitles.
sentences.translation: Filmlarni subtitrsiz **ko'rsangiz**, ingliz tilingiz tez **yaxshilanishi mumkin**.

examples.title: **If** + imperative: instructions and advice
examples.description: Natija qismida buyruq gap: iltimos, ko'rsatma, maslahat. O'zbekchada ham shunday: «Ko'rsang, ayt», «Kechiksam, kutmanglar».

sentences.text: **If** you **see** Bekzod, **tell** him to call me.
**Call** an ambulance **if** someone **is** badly hurt.
**If** you**'re** cold, **close** the window.
**Don't wait** for me **if** I**'m** late.
**Ask** the teacher **if** you **don't understand** something.
**If** the phone **rings**, please **answer** it.
Please **send** me a message **if** your train **is** delayed.
**Take** the number 15 bus **if** you **want** to get to the old city.
**Help** yourself to more plov **if** you**'re** still hungry.
sentences.translation: Hali ham **qorningiz och bo'lsa**, yana palov **oling**.

sentences.text: **Don't worry** **if** you **make** mistakes — everybody does.

examples.title: **If** + present, present: always true
examples.description: Har doim to'g'ri bo'ladigan narsalar (tabiat qonunlari, odatlar): ikkala qismda ham Present Simple. Bu yerda **if** ma'nosi **when** ga yaqin.

sentences.text: **If** you **heat** ice, it **melts**.
Plants **die** **if** they **don't get** enough water.
My little brother **gets** angry **if** he **loses** a game.
**If** I **drink** coffee after six, I **can't sleep** at night.
sentences.translation: Soat oltidan keyin qahva **ichsam**, kechasi **uxlay olmayman**.

sentences.text: Our cat **hides** under the bed **if** somebody **rings** the doorbell.
sentences.translation: Kimdir eshik qo'ng'irog'ini **chalsa**, mushugimiz karavot ostiga **yashirinadi**.

sentences.text: Red and yellow **make** orange **if** you **mix** them.
sentences.translation: Qizil va sariqni **aralashtirsangiz**, to'q sariq rang **hosil bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Aziz always **walks** to work **if** the weather **is** fine.
sentences.translation: Havo **yaxshi bo'lsa**, Aziz doim ishga **piyoda boradi**.

sentences.text: **If** there**'s** a lot of snow, the mountain roads **close**.
You **feel** sleepy in the afternoon **if** you **eat** a big lunch.
The museum **is** free **if** you **are** under eighteen.

examples.title: **if** or **when**?
examples.description: **when** — voqea albatta bo'ladi («`-gach`», «`-ganda`»); **if** — bo'lishi ham, bo'lmasligi ham mumkin («`-sa`»). Juftliklarni solishtiring.

sentences.text: **When** I **get** home, I'll have a shower.
**If** I **get** home early, I'll cook dinner.
I'll call you **when** the plane **lands**.
I'll call you **if** the plane **is** late.
We'll go to the café **when** the lesson **finishes**.
We'll go to the park **if** the lesson **finishes** early.
**When** Madina **finishes** university next year, she'll work as an engineer.
sentences.translation: Madina kelasi yili universitetni **bitirgach**, muhandis bo'lib ishlaydi.

sentences.text: **If** Madina **fails** the exam, she'll take it again in August.
Text me **when** you **leave** the office.
Text me **if** you **can't come** tonight.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **kela olmasang**, menga yozib qo'y.

examples.title: Dialogue: a picnic on Sunday
examples.description: Do'stlar piknik rejalashtirmoqda: real shart (**if** + Present Simple, **will**) va **when** suhbatda.

sentences.text: — **Will** you **come** to our picnic **if** the weather **is** nice on Sunday?
— Yes, I'd love to. But what will you do **if** it **rains**?
sentences.translation: — Ha, jonim bilan. Lekin yomg'ir **yog'sa**, nima qilasizlar?

sentences.text: — **If** it **rains**, we**'ll have** the picnic at my house.
— Great. I can make a salad **if** you **like**.
— Yes, please! And **if** you **have** time, bring your guitar too.
sentences.translation: — Ha, iltimos! Vaqting **bo'lsa**, gitarangni ham olib kel.

sentences.text: — OK. I'll come at eleven **if** that**'s** all right.
sentences.translation: — Mayli. **Ma'qul bo'lsa**, soat o'n birda kelaman.

sentences.text: — Perfect. **When** you **get** to our street, call me and I'll meet you.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Ko'chamizga **yetib kelganingda** qo'ng'iroq qil, chiqib kutib olaman.

sentences.text: — **Will** Aziz be there? I **won't know** anybody **if** he **doesn't come**.
— Don't worry. He**'ll** definitely **come** **if** he **isn't** working.
— Fine. **If** anything **changes**, send me a message.
